C1101.title: AI Face-Swapping Scam Drains 4.3 Million Yuan in 10 Minutes
C1101.summary: In April 2023, a Mr. Guo in Fuzhou received a WeChat video call from a close friend requesting 4.3 million yuan as a guarantee deposit. Trusting the familiar face on video, Guo transferred the funds. It was later discovered that fraudsters had used AI face-swapping technology to impersonate his friend.
